hypothesis: Known training/evaluation leakage and post-freeze mutation can be made fail-closed by a deterministic corpus manifest binding exact and normalized content hashes, source lineage, provenance, explicit independently assigned semantic-family identity, split identity and one complete manifest root.
strongest_counterhypothesis: A manifest can create false confidence if semantic-family discovery is incomplete, caller-controlled, contaminated or bypassed by the real corpus pipeline; therefore the mechanism cannot itself establish semantic decontamination or final training-data acceptance.
